procedure: EA-NEGONT-02 v0.9 §3.4 D/R/O (working; not frozen). The string pass over 1,711 archive texts found no D or R candidate: no deposit text names Presenc, presenc.ai or the byline's name Ramanath (also checked by grep over data/texts, data/blog-index.json and data/blog-corpus: no hit; data/ holds the name only in the capture's own records). The registry's entity triples matched once, #99, on a truncated note ('*presenc' of 'presence'), not the entity. O-class ran on four sourced classes (config): generative engine optimization, GEO (case-sensitive), answer engine optimization / AEO, and AI visibility; 370 sentences in 69 deposits, every one an O-class candidate (a sentence that names the class and contains an archive category term). Admission by reading: a deposit is admitted to O when its sentence or paragraph applies an archive category to GEO (or AEO, or AI visibility monitoring) as a class; a sentence on SPXI's distinctness, a citation of a title, a homonym (the archive's own EA-GEO-01, the Geocoded Basin) or a claim on the King of AEO contest is not. Where an admitted deposit's defining sentence on the class carries no archive category term, the string pass did not return it; it is read from the admitted candidate's paragraph or from the deposit's section on GEO, and the ledger says so ('read_from'). The hop (H) was not run: it runs from admitted D/R/O deposits, and the admitted deposits bear on the class, not the entity (as at papers-with-code). The archive's own records of the entity are not deposits and are reached outside the string pass: the Capture Registry's entry (findings and analysis) and the MMRS meta-aggregator record (census.json row presenc-geo-papers; articles.py, and the two neighbours' articles where they name or contrast the entity), ledgered as CAP-1-NN and MMRS-NN.
